transcript:
Meeting: Q4 Roadmap / Launch Readiness / Post-Incident Review
Date: 2026-08-25 10:00 PDT
Duration: ~75 minutes
Attendees: Alex Martinez, Priya Shah, Marco Ruiz, Jenna Lee, Sam O'Neil

Summary: quick internal sync to go over the outage on Tuesday, make sure Dedicated beta is still on track for the September pilot, and lock down owners for launch readiness items.

00:00 Alex: okay everyone, thanks for joining, we're gonna kick off, I know we have a packed agenda, we'll do incident first, then launch blockers, then prioritization. if you've got doc links throw them in the chat.
00:14 Marco: yeah, I put the logs in drive, there's a link in the calendar invite, but short version, the 8-18 outage was a cascade from a bad autoscaler config plus a KV cache eviction storm, so we saw latency spikes then tail failures.
00:29 Priya: sorry, can you repeat the KV cache bit?
00:33 Marco: sure, so the prefix/KV cache entries were evicted when memory pressure hit a host, and because our continuous batching depends on those entries we had a bunch of cold-start tokens and the runtime then started to pick suboptimal kernels, which amplified latency, and the autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough because of an incorrect cooldown setting.
00:50 Jenna: and this is the Dedicated pool only? or did it affect hosted?
00:54 Marco: primarily Dedicated pools in us-west-2, some customers on hosted API had elevated lat but not full failures.
01:05 Sam: that's rough; do we have an overlap with the new quantization changes? I think we merged the quantize-opt branch same day?
01:10 Priya: yes, we merged a lightweight quantization patch but it's not the root cause. there's some interplay but the main vector was the autoscaler cool-down plus the eviction policy.
01:23 Alex: action item — Marco please draft the RCA and include the timeline and mitigation steps, target EOD Monday? is that reasonable?
01:31 Marco: yeah I can get a draft by Monday 8/30, will include logs, stack traces, and suggested config changes.
01:35 Alex: great. next, Dedicated beta launch blockers. Priya, status on autoscaler changes?
01:41 Priya: working on it, we have a PR open to change scale-out thresholds and reduce the cooldown from 300s to 45s for bursty workloads. still need perf testing because that could increase flapping on low-util clusters.
01:54 Sam: we can tolerate some flapping in the beta if it keeps latency SLOs for real workloads, but we need an automated fallback to a lower-cost model variant. can we do that?
02:06 Priya: yes, routing layer already has policy hooks. we can implement a rule: if median latency > 200ms for 60s, route to smaller-llama-variant or region fallback. will require testing.
02:19 Jenna: narrow question: what's our GA perf target we want to promise? last I remember was p50 < 120ms p95 < 450ms for single-turn gen at 2k tokens?
02:30 Alex: correct, and cost targets too, but for the beta pilot we can relax p95 to 600ms. core requirement is stability under 2x baseline traffic.
02:40 Priya: noted. I'll add targets to the PR description.
02:44 Marco: for the benchmark run, SRE will provision an extra test pool — need approval for one week of extra GPU run, should be small, maybe 4x A10 equivalents?
02:55 Sam: approve that, Marco, please send estimated cost to finance; I'll sign off.
03:04 Alex: on rollout plan: Jenna, can you coordinate the external readiness review with Solutions and Sales? we want sign-off before we start the pilot on 9/10.
03:14 Jenna: yes, I'll book that for 9/07 and invite CS and Sales leads. also will share the launch runbook draft today.
03:21 Alex: excellent. Now Q4 roadmap items — let's quick-prioritize. list is: Dedicated GA, Private VPC audit logs improvements, Optimize auto-batching improvements, new model catalog curation, and cost-awareness tooling.
03:35 Priya: from eng perspective, autoscaler, auto-batching, and KV cache improvements are highest priority. Private VPC audit logs is mostly product + security work but we need SRE support for retention.
03:47 Sam: resource-wise, we have two cross-team hires coming in October but for September we should be conservative. I'd prioritize: 1) autoscaler + rollback hooks, 2) automated canary rollouts, 3) audit log compliance features.
04:00 Alex: agreed. Decision: autoscaler and canary rollouts get green; audit logs scoped to minimal compliance (retention, KMS integration) for beta. full SOC2/ISO controls tracked separately.
04:12 Jenna: quick note on KMS — Product Security wants HSM gating for on-prem customers. is that in scope for Q4?
04:19 Sam: not for GA, but we need a design doc and an ETA. Priya, can Eng produce a design by end of Q4?
04:26 Priya: yes, design by 11/15 seems doable. implementation later.
04:31 Marco: back to incident mitigations, short-term patch is to change autoscaler cooldown and pin KV cache eviction thresholds. medium-term is to add better cache heatmap metrics and per-tenant cache quotas.
04:44 Alex: who owns per-tenant quotas?
04:47 Marco: SRE with eng; I'll take lead and Priya will be eng owner.
04:52 Priya: yep.
04:54 Alex: we should add a pre-launch benchmark: 48-hour stress test hitting 2x traffic with mixed prompts, measure p50/p95, kernel selection variance, and memory patterns. Priya/Marco to run next Tue/Wed.
05:09 Priya: note that kernel variance was observed during outage; runtime picked slower kernels once cache cold, we need to instrument kernel selection more clearly.
05:19 Alex: can we get tracing hooks in runtime to show kernel switches?
05:22 Priya: yes, small change, I'll include in PR.
05:25 Jenna: action — add the benchmark plan to the runbook and share with Sales/CS so expectations are set.
05:30 Sam: also, we should tell customers that the beta has safety nets — automatic fallback, canary rollouts, and 24/7 on-call coverage during pilot.
05:40 Alex: good point. let's make a short customer comms doc after the readiness review.
05:45 Marco: one more incident detail — during the outage, one of the k8s nodes had a Docker oom that caused a multi-pod restart, that increased our eviction rate. we need to tighten node-level memory limits and evictions to avoid cascade.
05:59 Priya: will update k8s resource quotas and set memoryRequest/memoryLimit defaults in the operator.
06:05 Alex: any other risks we should flag?
06:08 Jenna: Sales asked about data residency for EU customers, want clearer region commit. we should finalize regional rollout plan and get legal sign-off.
06:18 Sam: noted. Jenna, add an item to coordinate with Legal — target 9/10 to have EU region commit language.
06:26 Jenna: added.
06:28 Alex: okay, recapping owners: Marco — RCA and logs by 8/30; Priya — autoscaler PR and kernel tracing by 9/03; Priya+Marco — run benchmark 9/01-9/02; Jenna — readiness review scheduled 9/07 and customer comms; Sam — budget approval by 8/28. Alex — update runbook and send timeline to Sales by 8/27.
06:51 Sam: hmm Alex, can you put that timeline in the calendar invite so everyone has deadlines visible?
06:57 Alex: will do.
07:00 Alex: any blockers preventing us from the pilot on 9/10?
07:03 Priya: nothing major, just waiting on perf tests and autoscaler PR merge, but those are in flight.
07:10 Jenna: from Product Ops side, need Sales/CS alignment; I'll sync with them after readiness review.
07:16 Alex: cool, thanks everyone. meet adjourned.

Action items (restate):
- Marco - RCA draft + logs by 2026-08-30
- Priya - autoscaler PR + kernel tracing by 2026-09-03
- Priya & Marco - 48-hour stress benchmark on Dedicated pool 2026-09-01 -> 2026-09-02
- Jenna - schedule readiness review 2026-09-07; share runbook; coordinate Sales/CS
- Sam - approve test infra spend by 2026-08-28
- Alex - update launch runbook and calendar timelines by 2026-08-27

References: drive link to incident logs (link: drive.google.com/incident-2026-08-18), PR link for autoscaler (internal git link in invite), benchmark plan doc (internal link tbd).

Transcript end.
